summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery command in dsl2koru argv

delivery.outcome: Remove the code2llm 'Shotgun Surgery: command' report for packages/dsl2koru/src/dsl2koru/handlers/argv.py (PLF-041) by replacing the seven list-mutating _build_*_args builders (each grew a local command list via append/extend) with pure return [...] expressions over three shared argv-fragment helpers: _flag_args(payload, key, flag) for boolean flags, _value_args(payload, key, flag) for flag+value pairs and _positional_args(payload, key) for raw positionals. Flag placement policy now lives in exactly one place per fragment kind; the calibration skip-flag tuple moves to a module constant consumed by a genexp. Produced argv lists are byte-identical to before; to_cli_args, the _ARG_BUILDERS verb map, the dsl2coru re-export and the module's public surface are untouched. packages/dsl2koru/tests/test_argv.py pins to_cli_args output for every dispatched verb plus the unknown-verb fallback, captured against the pre-refactor implementation.
nonGoals: Changing any produced argv, flag order, default or fallback mapping
Touching handlers/command.py, handlers/runner.py or the dsl2coru compatibility re-export
Remediating any other smell reported for the dsl2koru or dsl2coru packages
Extracting argv.py into a new module (the smell is intra-module)

architecture.decision: Make every builder a single return expression that concatenates literal argv fragments with unpacked helper results, so no function in the module assigns or mutates a shared command local; the append/extend knowledge collapses into the three fragment helpers. No module extraction is needed (the smell is intra-module), so there are no new patch targets and the module import surface is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the single ticket commit to restore the seven list-mutating builders.

validation.evidence: No matches: no builder grows a command list any more.
36 to_cli_args pins (every dispatched verb, flag combinations and the unknown-verb fallback) pass against the refactored builders.
Full dsl2koru (99 baseline + 36 new) and dsl2coru (35 baseline) suites pass; no baseline regression.
Governance gate reports 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
